summary: Ubisoft Montreal's free-to-play roller-sport game, built around 3v3 arena matches, laps, passing, tackles, and live-service progression.

entries.title: Roller Champions
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC live-service client while available

emulation.notes: Run the active Windows client if servers remain available; emulation is not a practical preservation route for live-service play.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows PC client while service is online

primary.why: Roller Champions released as a free-to-play multiplayer game in 2022, with public platform sources listing Windows, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Xbox One, Xbox Series X/S, Nintendo Switch, and Amazon Luna across its release coverage. Windows is the highest-fidelity and most flexible route, but access depends on the live service remaining available.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Windows PC client through Ubisoft's current distribution path if the service remains online; console/cloud versions are alternatives with the same live-service dependency.
